subject: Recap + prompt/log collection for POC — success criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@acmecorp.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Recap + prompt/log collection for POC — success criteria & next steps

Thanks for taking the time today — great discussion. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we can get the POC moving: 

Summary / success criteria (as discussed):
- Business-critical intents pass rate >= 95% on customer validation prompts (intent-level pass/fail).
- End-user quality: human-rated helpfulness >= 4/5 on held-out prompt set.
- Latency: p95 generation latency < 350ms for the primary route under expected load.
- Cost guardrail: target cost per 1k tokens below our agreed threshold (we'll track during the POC).

Deliverables we need from AcmeCorp for the POC:
1) Prompt set: representative prompts covering top 20 intents + long-tail examples. Prefer CSV or JSONL with a column/field for intent, prompt, expected_answer (if available), and any metadata.
2) Production logs (anonymized): last 30 days of anonymized prompt/response pairs (sensitive fields redacted).
3) Annotation schema: if you have existing labels or pass/fail criteria, include those.

Format guidance (attached template):
- File: poc_prompt_dataset_template.csv (columns: intent, prompt_text, expected_response, tags)
- Alternate: JSONL where each line is {"intent":..., "prompt":..., "expected":...}
- Redaction: please remove PII and replace with [REDACTED]; keep message structure.

Timeline / ownership: 
- Please upload dataset to a shared S3/Drive by EOD 2026-12-12 (Sam / Priya ownership).
- We will do an intake review and follow up with any clarifying questions by 2026-12-14.
- Kickoff + data sync with SE team (Rishi + Marissa) on 2026-12-14 or 12-15.
- POC evaluation run: 2026-12-15 -> 2026-12-29.

Attachments: poc_prompt_dataset_template.csv, redwood_poc_eval-guidelines.pdf (eval metrics and example scripts). Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example-poc-materials

Next steps for you: confirm owners and whether you can meet the 12/12 dataset deadline; if not, propose an alternate date. Also let us know if you prefer S3 or Drive for the upload.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Recap + prompt/log collection for POC — success criteria & next steps

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. Confirming owners: Priya (engineering) will own pulling the logs and assembling the prompt set; I'll coordinate product-side validation and expected responses. 

A couple quick clarifications: 
- For the prompt set size, do you have a recommended minimum per intent? We're thinking ~200-500 per top intent and fewer for long-tail.
- For logs, is there a minimum timeframe you prefer? We can provide 30 days, 90 days if helpful (anonymized).
- We'll need a short checklist for redaction to share with the data team.

We can target 12/12 for the initial upload to an S3 bucket (we'll send Share permissions). If anything blocks that, we'll update you.

—Sam
Sam Lee
Senior PM, Search & Assist
AcmeCorp
sam.lee@acmecorp.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@acmecorp.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-06T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + prompt/log collection for POC — success criteria & next steps

Thanks Sam — great questions. A few recommendations from the SE side to make the intake efficient: 

Recommended sample sizes:
- Top 5 intents: 500-1,000 prompts each (if available)
- Next 15 intents: 200-500 prompts each
- Long-tail / edge cases: 50-200 each

Logs timeframe: 30 days is fine for an initial run; 90 days can help surface seasonality but isn't required.

Redaction checklist (high level):
- Remove direct PII (emails, phone numbers, SSNs) and replace with [REDACTED].
- Keep entity structure (e.g., "Order #12345" -> "Order #[REDACTED]").
- If you have a hashing process for ids that's fine — just include mapping notes internally (do not share mappings).

Formats we accept: CSV, JSONL (preferred for nested metadata), or ndjson. Include a small sample (100 rows) in the initial upload so we can validate schema quickly.

Proposed POC schedule (SE timeline):
- 12/12: dataset upload by AcmeCorp (initial sample + full set).
- 12/14: data intake call — schema validation & clarifying q's.
- 12/15-12/19: run candidate model variants and baseline evals.
- 12/20-12/29: iterative tuning, evals, and documentation of results.
- 12/30: internal review and prep for final demo.

Eval metrics we'll produce (examples):
- Intent pass rate (binary pass/fail) per intent
- Aggregate helpfulness (human-rated) on stratified sample
- Safety/regression checks (hallucination rate on factual prompts)
- Latency p95 and cost per 1k tokens for the configuration used

I'll attach an example sample file (example_prompts.jsonl) and the evaluation checklist. Also looping in Dev Patel on the security/compliance details (will reach out separately for encryption and access controls).

Action items:
- Acme: upload sample and full dataset to agreed location by 12/12 (Sam / Priya).
- Redwood (Rishi): validate schema within 48 hours of upload and confirm SE kickoff slot.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk through the template live.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-12-06T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + prompt/log collection for POC — success criteria & next steps

Hi team — thanks for the clear guidance. Priya here — we'll aim to upload the sample + full dataset to S3 by COB 2026-12-12. A few notes: 

- We'll include system prompts and any pre- or post-processing steps in a README.
- For expected_response, should we include a single canonical answer, or multiple acceptable variations? We can include canonical + a small set of acceptable alternatives where relevant.
- We'll redact PII per your checklist and include a small redaction report.

I'll send an S3 link once the upload is complete and grant cross-account read access to the Redwood SE role. If you need anything sooner (e.g., a small sample to sanity-check), tell us and we'll prioritize a 100-row sample by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Priya Singh
